name: mass-l3-tactical-layer
description: Colcon-based ROS2 workspace for the L3 tactical decision layer of the MASS (Maritime Autonomous Surface Ship) ADAS system.

scripts.sys:start: docker compose up -d && pm2 start ecosystem.config.cjs
scripts.sys:stop: pm2 delete ecosystem.config.cjs && docker compose down
scripts.sys:restart: pm2 restart ecosystem.config.cjs && docker compose restart
scripts.sil:restart: docker compose restart sil-nodes sil-orchestrator foxglove-bridge
scripts.sil:rebuild: docker compose build sil-nodes && docker compose up -d
scripts.sil:rebuild:orch: docker compose build sil-orchestrator && docker compose up -d sil-orchestrator
scripts.sil:prune: docker image prune -f && docker builder prune -f --keep-storage 5GB
